description.de: Als Hana in ihrem Lieblingsroman im Körper der schönen Herzogin Cielina aufwacht, ist sie mehr als nur geschockt – schließlich soll diese Figur laut der Geschichte einen elenden Tod sterben. In der Hoffnung, dadurch ihr Schicksal abzuwenden, entscheidet sich dazu, ruhig und unauffällig weiterzuleben; doch dann kommen beunruhigende Gerüchte über ihren Ehemann Herzog Killian Seyfried auf: Er soll seinen Neffen und seine Nichte eigenhändig umgebracht haben. Während Cielina diesen Gerüchten auf den Grund geht, findet sie heraus, dass die Familie ihres Gatten von einem Fluch heimgesucht wird, der die Kinder in den Augen anderer wie wilde Bestien aussehen lässt – und es stellt sich außerdem heraus, dass ihre wahre Form nur durch Cielinas Umarmung sichtbar wird. So verstrickt sie sich immer weiter in die Geheimnisse der Familie und erfährt, dass sie von einer Göttin in die Welt des Romans gebracht wurde, um den Fluch der Seyfrieds zu brechen. Aber kann Cielina es schaffen, das Mysterium um diese Familie zu lösen und ihr eigenes Schicksal verändern?
description.en: When Hana wakes up in a novel as Cielina, a character who is destined to die, she decides to keep a low profile—until disturbing rumors surface that her husband, Duke Killian Seyfried, killed his own niece and nephew. Diving into the mystery, she uncovers a haunting family curse that renders the children monstrous in others’ eyes. Yet, Cielina’s touch reveals their true forms. As she digs deeper, Cielina discovers she’s been transported into this world by a goddess with a mission: to lift the Seyfried family’s dark curse. Can she unravel the family’s twisted secrets and alter her own fate?
description.es: Cuando Hana se despierta en una novela como Cielina, un personaje destinado a morir, decide mantener una superficie de rumores inquietantes de bajo perfil que su esposo, el Duke Killian Seyfried, mató a su propia sobrina y sobrino. Al sumergirse en el misterio, descubre una maldición familiar inquietante que hace que los niños sean monstruosos a los ojos de los demás. Sin embargo, el toque de Cielina revela sus verdaderas formas. Mientras cava más profundo, Cielina descubre que una diosa ha sido transportada a este mundo con una misión: levantar la oscura maldición de la familia Seyfried. ¿Puede desentrañar los secretos retorcidos de la familia y alterar su propio destino?
description.fr: Quand Hana se réveille dans le corps de Cielina, un personnage voué à mourir dans le roman dont elle est tirée, elle décide de se faire discrète. Seulement, peu après son arrivée, elle entend d'étranges rumeurs racontant que son mari, le duc Killian Seyfried, aurait tué ses propres neveu et nièce. En enquêtant un peu plus sur cette sombre affaire, elle découvre que la famille du duc est en réalité victime d’une terrible malédiction. Les neveu et nièce du duc n’ont pas été tués, mais sont en réalité cachés du reste du monde. Cielina découvre bien vite que les deux adorables jeunes enfants qu’elle a rencontrés apparaissent sous forme de deux terrifiants dragons aux yeux de n’importe quels autres humains. Elle apprendra ensuite qu’elle a été amenée dans ce monde par une déesse et qu’elle a une mission: sauver la famille du duc de sa malédiction.
description.id: Ketika Hana terbangun dalam sebuah novel sebagai Cielina, karakter yang ditakdirkan untuk mati, dia memutuskan untuk tidak menonjolkan diri — sampai desas-desus yang mengganggu muncul bahwa suaminya, Duke Killian Seyfried, membunuh keponakannya sendiri. Menyelam ke dalam misteri, dia mengungkap kutukan keluarga yang menghantui yang membuat anak-anak mengerikan di mata orang lain. Namun, sentuhan Cielina mengungkapkan bentuk asli mereka. Saat dia menggali lebih dalam, Cielina menemukan bahwa dia telah diangkut ke dunia ini oleh seorang dewi dengan misi: untuk mengangkat kutukan gelap keluarga Seyfried. Bisakah dia mengungkap rahasia keluarga yang bengkok dan mengubah nasibnya sendiri?

Погружаясь в тайну дома, она узнает о семейном проклятье, которое делает детей чудовищами в глазах окружающих.
Сможет ли она разгадать запутанные секреты семьи и изменить свою собственную судьбу?

Kang Hyeon Ho, who belongs in the university soccer team goes into a breadth class and encounters the person he went to middle school together with and was his first love, Han Gyeol. To avoid the regret of not properly conveying his feelings again, Kang Hyeon Ho approaches Han Gyeol, but after losing his parents and left in a relative's house with a younger brother, he works hard in part time job and doesn't give his heart easily.

description.en:
Florence Café’s owner, Yoo Ji-an, has someone who feels more like an older brother than her real one.

That person is Choi Jae-geon, the heir of Hwaseong Construction, who never misses a chance to get on Ji-an’s nerves.

One day, after an unexpected incident leaves Ji-an with nowhere to go, Jae-geon is the one to reach out first.

“Come to my place.”

And so begins their cohabitation.

They’ve always bickered and clashed at every turn, but suddenly, the atmosphere between them starts to shift.

Then, with just one sentence from Jae-geon—

“Come to my room.”

Ji-an’s heart starts to race.

KIM's hit novel, Come to My Place, now adapted into a webtoon!
Familiar yet unfamiliar, in a home that isn’t her own—
A fiery love-hate romance begins!

description.id: Choi A-ran, seorang novelis dan CEO penerbit, menjalankan perusahaan penerbitan 20 tahun yang lalu, menyembunyikan fakta bahwa dia seorang penulis internet terkenal dengan novel tentang cinta Sanggo dan seorang gadis SMA biasa, Jo A Han. Suatu hari, A ran pergi ke rumah orang tuanya untuk memberitahukan jika dia telah memutuskan pertunangannya. Namun, A Ran kehilangan kesadaran dan dibawa ke dunia fiksi internet, "Cheonyang City". Kota Cheonyang sangat berbeda dari kenyataan. Orang tua yang awalnya telah bercerai membangunkan Aran dengan ramah, dan ada emoticon yang mengekspresikan emosi di dalam ballon dialog. Ejaan yang buruk! adegan ynag klise! A ran tiba-tiba pergi ke sekolah dan menyadari bahwa ini adalah dunia fiksi internet yang terus-menerus terjadi. Ini adalah dunia yang A Ran ciptakan, jadi A Ran bisa melarikan diri! Saat mencari cara untuk melarikan diri, dia pergi ke pusat kota bersama temannya So-young dan melihat Raja SanGo di ruang permainan. Aran jatuh dari tangga dan jatuh ke atas Kang Hwi-young. "Oh, tidak! Jika Aku jatuh di sini, apapun caraku jatuh, aku akan mencium Sango!"
description.ko:
소설가이자 출판사 CEO 최아란은 자신이 20년 전,
상고짱과 평범한 여고생의 사랑을 다룬 소설로 대히트한
인소작가 조아한이라는 치부를 숨긴 채 출판사를 운영하고 있다.

어느 날 아란은 파혼 사실을 알리기 위해
어릴 때 살았던 부모님 댁을 찾았다가 정신을 잃으며
인터넷 소설의 세계인 ‘천양시’로 빨려 들어간다.

천양시는 현실과 전혀 다르다.
이혼했던 부모님이 다정하게 아란을 깨우고,
말풍선 안에는 감정을 표현하는 이모티콘이 떠 있다.
맞춤법은 엉망! 클리셰 범벅!
아란은 얼떨결에 학교에 가면서 이곳이 인터넷 소설의 법칙이
끊임없이 일어나는 소설 속 세계라는 것을 눈치챈다.

내가 만든 세상이니 탈출할 수 있어!
탈출법을 모색하던 도중 친구 소영과 함께 시내에 가게 되고,
오락실에서 상고 사천왕을 보게 된다.
아란은 계단에서 떨어지며
상고짱 강휘영 위로 넘어지게 되는데...

‘아, 안 돼! 여기서 넘어지면 떨어지는 자세와 상관없이
높은 확률로 상고 짱과 뽀뽀하게 되어버려!’
description.ru: Чхве А-ран - писательница, управляет издательской компанией и скрывает свое прошлое, когда ее звали Джо А-хан, писательницы, которая сделала себе громкое имя 20 лет назад благодаря интернет-роману о популярном лидере Sanggo High. влюбляется в обычного старшеклассника. А-ран идет в дом своих родителей, где она выросла, чтобы объявить о расторжении помолвки, но теряет сознание и попадает в мир интернет-романов «Чонянси». Чоньянси полностью отличается от реальности. Ее теперь уже разведенные родители ласково будят А-ран, и в облачке над их головами появляются смайлики, выражающие чувства. Такая банальная болтовня! А-ран идет в школу и понимает, что это воображаемый мир, где постоянно действуют законы интернет-фантастики. «Это мир, который я придумала, поэтому я могу сбежать!» В поисках способа вернуться домой она отправляется в город со своей подругой Соён и встречает четырех небесных королей в аркаде. А-ран падает с лестницы и приземляется на Кан Хвиён, главу Санго-чана. 'О нет! Если ты упадешь вот так, есть большая вероятность, что ты поцелуешь Санго-чан, независимо от того, в каком положении ты падаешь!

description.en:
There are also altruistic people in the selfish world.

"Nothing is more precious than human life. Isn't it?" "Of course it is." Do you know what it means to save one person?"

"What are you talking about?"

Team leader Lee Chae-Yong smiled when Tae-gun tilted his head.

"If you save one person, you're going to save his family."

"What?"

"What would happen to the future of his family and acquaintances if he were dead?"

Those few words changed Tae-gun's life.

Today, we live in, is the tomorrow that someone who died yesterday longed for.
So that you can risk your life to draw another person's life and continue the story of life,

What if I do?

description.ko:
이기적인 세상에 이타적인 사람들이 있기도 하다.

“사람 목숨만큼 귀한 건 없다……. 아닙니까?”
“물론 그렇지. 그런데 한 사람을 구한다는 의미를 알아?”
“무슨 말씀이신지?”
태건이 고개를 갸웃거리자 이채용 팀장이 빙그레 웃었다. 
“한 사람을 구하면, 나아가 그 사람 가족을 구하는 거야.” 
“네?”
“그 사람이 죽었다면 가족들 그리고 지인들 미래는 어쩌겠니?”
 
그 몇 마디가 태건의 인생을 바꿨다.
우리가 사는 오늘은, 어제 죽은 누군가가 갈망한 내일이다.
 

목숨을 걸고 타인의 생명을 그리고 삶의 스토리를 이어갈 수 있게 한다면?
결코 돈으로도 살 수 없는 보람이다. 
콜사인!
살려달란 소리에 반사적으로 움직일 수 있는 원동력이다.

Bohm (meaning spring in Korean), on his way to give his dad, Detective Ghim, (who's been working for 10 days straight) some underpants at the police station, sees a girl by a vending machine and wishes to see her again…  
  
Mahnsoo, a boy with a strange lonely past, the only witness to an important criminal case, must undergo a disguise as a girl and stay together with Detective Ghim's family until the investigation is over and the case ends. So he meets Bohm again, and trying to get close to his new icy brother is not easy…

description.en:
In the grand empire of Tygen, Robellia's serene life takes a dark turn, catapulting her into a saga of vengeance. In a world of power and intrigue, she exposes hidden truths, navigating a tumultuous path between hero and villain. Armed with extraordinary magic, Robellia is steadfast in unveiling the obscured secrets of the empire and recovering her lost happiness.

---
Robellia isn't so foolish as to believe in a happy life. She was robbed of such flowery optimism the day her husband betrayed her and her child was lost. Now, armed with the power to exact revenge on those who scorned her, she's determined to expose the lies and deceit behind the empire she calls her home. But can she come out the other side as a redeemable person once all is said and done?
Killer boy MinJun's life starts to change after meeting a girl.

Her late parent's death made her feel lonely. She couldn't trust anyone, particularly when she can hear their true thoughts, so she always felt lonely. This was true, until she visited the aquarium.  
  
"It was the first time since I was born that I heard someone's voice and thought it was beautiful."  
"Can I listen to you one more time?"

Win love! Win 500 million won! A competition begins where three single women in their thirties put 500 million won on the line to break free from being single. A princess without her prince, Gong Jurim, a trash collector, Kang Seon, and a firm believer in premarital purity, Kim Chaeyul! Who will be the ultimate winner of this singles showdown?

description.en: Chaewoon is back in school after taking 2 years off. She doesn't want any trouble and wants to graduate without any incident but she can't seem to help but get entangled with not only the most popular guy in the department, Sado, but also the hot-blooded freshmen Mingyu! So much for wanting a quiet school year!

A thousand years ago, a war erupted between humans, backed by "Lifespans," and the gods. In this war, there was one god who fought on the side of humans, her name was "Ogu."

The defeated "Lifespans" were divided into ten thousand insects and scattered across the world, while Ogu, the god, found herself caught in the cycle of reincarnation.

After a thousand years, Ogu is reborn in the body of a young girl named "Bari," and the "Lifespans" show signs of resurrection as well.

Two horrific wars must not happen again! Bari and Ogu embark on a journey to thwart the plans of the "Lifespans" and find the divine beings.

Will Bari be able to save humanity and prove her existence on this journey?

Son Joong-gil, the chairman of the Jaekyung Group, a prominent figure in South Korea during the 1990s, closes his eyes and, 30 years later, opens them as his grandson, Son Jung-hoon, in 2022. Compared to 30 years ago, the Jaekyung Group has noticeably declined. Son Joong-gil is determined to restore the group he built back to its former glory.

description.en:
A nation that lives in the depths of the sea. Taerang the king of the White Seas has not had a heart since he was born. To have it he must take the heart of the woman who loves him. But Taerang, who cannot have contact with any woman due to a curse, was giving up on life. Surprisingly, appears Solu, a woman who can touch him without activating the curse!

Then Taerang the existence of heaven and earth begins to try to get his heart back because of that woman!

The year 2045 is the era of flourishing plants.

Where parasitic flowers mutated humanity into monsters in an instant. Only a few survived and constructed the underground ‘City,’ but they oppress and suppress the remaining humans as they please.

Can ‘Garam’ find his brother Gaon in this chaotic world?
Have you ever fallen in love with a girl sitting next to you? His love has begun just like that.

All I wanted was an ordinary life. That is all I wanted. But thanks to my dad (a lovely gangster), I don't get to live an ordinary life. So then all I wanted was just ONE thing. I wanted to have a normal school life like other girls my age. So what should I do when I get a fiance who is gorgeous…but has a dirty personality?!

High school student Kang Chul-joing awoke in an unknown locked room.
He finds himself in a chaotic situation, he searched around the room and found an old MP3.
What he learned from the message left on the MP3 was that he was poisoned and that he had only three hours left to live.
Kang Chul-joong, who was usually a mystery quiz enthusiast, tries to escape the unknown room by finding clues based on his reasoning skills that he has accumulated over the years.
However, the reality is different from the ideal.
What is the last clue that he noticed when he made a series of mistakes and ended up in an urgent situation where the poison spread and he start vomiting blood?!

A new survival game presented by Baek Ji-woon the creator of "Struggle" and "Undead King"!
Is there any way to escape this hellish secret room!
description.ko:
평범한 고등학생이었던 강철중, 어느 날 그가 잠에서 깨어나보니 처음 보는 밀실에 갇혀 있었다.
혼란스러운 상황에서 주변을 뒤져 발견한 것은 낡은 MP3 하나.
MP3에 남아있던 메시지로 알게 된 것은 자신이 독이 중독되어 있다는 것과 앞으로 목숨이 3시간밖에 남지 않았다는 충격적인 사실이었다.
평소 추리 퀴즈 마니아였던 강철중은 몇 년 동안 쌓아온 추리 실력을 토대로 단서를 찾아 밀실을 탈출하려고 노력한다.
하지만 이상과 현실은 다른 법.
실수를 연발하다 결국 독이 퍼져 피를 토하는 급박한 상황에 이르게 된 그의 눈에 띈 마지막 단서는 과연?!

<스트러글> <언데드킹>의 백지운 작가가 선보이는 새로운 생존 게임!
이 지옥 같은 밀실을 탈출할 방법은 있을 것인가!
description.pt-br: um estudante do ensino médio Kang Chul-joing acordou em uma sala trancada desconhecida. Ele se encontra em uma situação caótica, ele vasculha a sala é encontra um MP3 antigo. O que ele soube da mensagem deixada no MP3 foi que ele foi envenenado e que lhe restavam apenas três horas de vida. Kang Chul-joong, que geralmente era um entusiasta do questionário misterioso, tenta escapar da sala desconhecida encontrando pistas com base em suas habilidades de raciocínio que acumulou ao longo dos anos. No entanto, a realidade é diferente do ideal. Qual é a última pista que ele percebeu quando cometeu uma série de erros e acabou em uma situação de urgência onde o veneno se espalhou e ele começou a vomitar sangue?! Um novo jogo de sobrevivência apresentado por Baek Ji-woon, o criador de "Struggle" e "Undead King"! Existe alguma maneira de escapar desta sala secreta infernal!?

After the rapid increase of population, the vampires are abundant with blood, and they start to become picky about the taste of it. It leads to an era where they age human blood like wine. Harry, the chairman of Kingston Winery, the leading company in the business, loses his company to his older brother Max. Kicked out of the company that was once his, Harry is now running a small wine bar in Korea, where he also trades blood illegally. Then one day, a called Yeonseo visits the wine bar. Harry senses that even though her blood is now immature, it could be worth a lot of money when aged properly. description.en:
From parents forcibly married, whose only shared passion is mutual disdain, a neglected child is born—Leoni.
Yearning for affection as a child, Leoni loses her mother to illness, only for her father to auction her hand in marriage.
Enduring three arranged marriages, Leoni faces further hardship when she is falsely accused of a capital offense, seemingly destined for a bitter end.
"Those who orchestrated my misery... Every single one of them... shall pay...!"
Perhaps by force of will, Leoni finds herself back in childhood, with memories intact—and her ire.
Now, she must reclaim her life and seek long-awaited happiness. But first, there are debts of suffering to be paid. And Leoni is coming to collect.
*(Source: Pocketcomics)*

description.fr: Née entre deux parents qui se détestaient, Léoni a grandi sans amour, affamée d’affection et de reconnaissance. Le jour où sa mère meurt d’une étrange maladie, son père la vend comme épouse dans un mariage arrangé. Après trois unions marquées par la souffrance et la trahison, Léoni meurt injustement… mais sa haine et sa volonté de vengeance la ramènent dans son enfance. Cette fois, elle ne se laissera plus briser. Elle changera son destin, retrouvera sa liberté — et fera payer à tous ceux qui l’ont détruite.
description.id: Merindukan kasih sayang saat kecil, Leoni kehilangan ibunya karena sakit, hanya untuk ayahnya untuk melelang tangannya dalam pernikahan. Menanggung tiga perjodohan, Leoni menghadapi kesulitan lebih lanjut ketika dia dituduh melakukan pelanggaran modal, tampaknya ditakdirkan untuk akhir yang pahit. "Mereka yang mengatur penderitaanku... Setiap satu dari mereka... harus membayar ...!" Mungkin dengan kekuatan kehendak, Leoni menemukan dirinya kembali di masa kanak-kanak, dengan kenangan utuh—dan kekaisaran. Sekarang, dia harus merebut kembali hidupnya dan mencari kebahagiaan yang sudah lama ditunggu-tunggu. Tapi pertama-tama, ada utang penderitaan yang harus dibayar. Dan Leoni datang untuk mengumpulkan.

description.ru:
— Теперь ты можешь спокойно закрыть глаза. Я заставлю их впасть в отчаяние.
Леони, результат сотрудничества двух, враждующих на протяжении многих лет, семей, узнав о смерти своей матери, сбегает из дома и попадает в несчастный случай.
Очнувшись через несколько дней, в Леони, которая была лишена родительской любви и жила в доме с ненавидящими друг друга родителями, уже не было той невинности, присущей 10-летнему ребёнку.
В день похорон её матери, которые вскоре состоялись, её отец приказал Леони перед скорбящими:
— Будь вежлива со своей мачехой и сестрой.
— Папа, это моя сестра? - на руках её отца, который никогда прежде ни разу даже не обнял Леони, спросила невинным голосом девочка, которую назвали её младшей сестрой.
— Да, она.
— Тц, я не хочу.
— Прости, но иногда приходится делать то, что тебе не нравится, чтобы быть хорошим дворянином.
— Эй! Меня раздражает то, что я должна делить папину любовь, но я ничего не могу с этим поделать. Я приму тебя как свою семью, - сказала девочка, схватившись за подол своего великолепного платья, и присела в реверенсе.
— Не волнуйся. Не нужно ничего делить.
«Потому что мне не нужна семья, мне нужна месть».

title.en: How to Reject a Perfect Marriage

description.en:
The Tezen ducal family, wielding the utmost power, and O’Hara County, possessing all the wealth in the world—their union could not have been more perfect than this.

Except there was no burning love.

“Evangeline O’Hara is a prepared duchess. It would be troublesome to find another woman now, and there is no guarantee that she would do as well as Evangeline.”

For Dekarno, there was no Duchess better than her.

So, if it was only about bankruptcy, he could bear with it.

However, she couldn’t.

“Let’s put an end to this, now.”
“…Are you suggesting canceling the engagement?”
“Yes.”

Evangeline had given up everything she had brought so far and now walked away barehanded.

By relinquishing everything, she could let go of that man, too.

Even the feelings she had held alone.

“I liked you, Your Grace.”
“….”
“No way. Your Grace didn’t think I was only coveting the position of Duchess, did you?”

How could she leave so easily after claiming she liked him? Dekarno couldn’t understand, and his anger boiled inside.

The increasingly entangled events, the complicated thoughts—all of it traced back to that woman.

In the end, there was no choice but to put everything back in its place.

He set out to find Evangeline, who was desperately trying to stand on her own.

“You claim you’ll survive. It’s unbearable for a mere human like me to endure.”

Poseía a la hermana mayor de un hombre que se arrepiente de haber acumulado todo tipo de karma.

Según la historia original, morirá de una enfermedad incurable brindará una oportunidad para que el joven amo se vuelva torcido…
Tal rol es una mejor.

Después de leer el original, supe la cura para la enfermedad. Contacto físico constante con una persona con un poder divino desbordante.

Ese era Karen, el tercer príncipe de Cheon-deok y el hermano mayor de Yeo-ju. Entonces, decidí apuntar al contacto físico a través de un compromiso por contrato.

—Si nuestra familia es útil para el príncipe, puede usarla.

Mi cuñado es malo conmigo, pero ¿qué es? Gracias a su poder divino, es una cura que naturalmente cura mi enfermedad aunque la tenga en la mano. Ahora que tenemos una cura, es hora de luchar por una vida de agua blanca cristalina como la miel y una cuchara de oro.

—Sí, hola… ¡Cómo puedes ser tan inmaduro!

Incluso usa la máscara del pobre amante.

A veces uso una mascara de oscuridad, y el dia de mi divorcio ha llegado porque he estado ocupado viviendo.

de paso…

Pour sauver sa peau et changer son destin, elle décide de prendre Kian sous son aile et de le choyer afin qu'il ne devienne pas le grand méchant sanguinaire décrit dans le roman. Kian, sauvé du marché aux esclaves par Olivia, va très vite se prendre d'affection pour sa bienfaitrice qui, elle, n'avait pas envisagé que les choses tournent de cette façon. Arriveront-ils à changer le cours de l'histoire? Kian peut-il échapper à son avenir sanguinaire et Olivia à sa fin tragique?

description.en: What if all the people who were still unemployed by the age of 29 are dragged to the 'Youth Market'? The story of the world's most dangerous youth begins!!!

Twenty-Fifth Bam must journey skyward in a mysterious tower if he has any chance of reuniting with his best friend Rachel, even if that means facing his own death.

Before mysteriously disappearing into the tower gates before his very eyes, Rachel cautions Bam to forget all about her. Unwilling to lose her, Bam enters the Tower completely surrounded by Shinsu — a divine and magical water, at his own peril.

The Tower itself contains multitudes of floors as vast as continents, each one with its unique geography, language and culture. Confronted by skillful tests each step of the way, Bam meets powerful guardians and otherworldly environments, making his quest to the top no easy feat.

Beginning his journey, Bam is met by Headon, the first floor guardian and caretaker of the Tower who explains the rules of the Tower. At each level Bam is constantly tested for his strength, dexterity and wit. With help from fellow travelers and unlikely villains, Bam makes both allies and enemies in order to find Rachel; however her intentions of reconnecting with him become unclear as misinformation about her whereabouts do not add up. Behind each ascension is a revelation about their friendship, revealing a much deeper, darker secret.

description.en: I am an abandoned princess - No, she was an abandoned princess. Until I met my lovely moneylender, the Marquis Joseph Patello. “If Your Highness wishes, we may throw the imperial family into the abyss.” Yeah, I can't back off so easily. It's time to take revenge on those who have looked down on me and reign as emperor. "Marquis Joseph, I will give you a chance to become my knight." Now, let's start a joke and pretend to do a comeback, shall we?

At first glance Moolchi is just another shy, unassuming boy whose greatest talents are running away from bullies and binging on vitamin supplements. Then one day, Moolchi's absentee father sends him a most unusual gift–a stunningly-proportioned automaton. She calls herself "Six" and mumbles about having a "prime directive." This strange and exquisite creature quickly turns the boy's life upside-down, violently disposing of high school hooligans and anybody else who gets in his or her way. The word "oblivious" barely does him justice as Moolchi remains blissfully unaware of his father's dangerous double-life, or the cute hall monitor who harbors a crush on him, or the intentions of this mysterious femme fatale who insists on bathing with him. Meanwhile, ominous storm clouds gather on the horizon, and one lingering question looms above the others "who is this so-called "Zero" that everybody is looking for?
